boundedRepairLeads.finding: Adds renewable technologies, demand/storage and societal/environmental constraints, not thermodynamic cycle/heat-transfer/force analysis.
Offers real partner-led sustainability research; brief/facilities do not guarantee mechanical engineering. No invented supervised mechanical project.
Adds reinforcement-learning agents; no physical actuator/dynamics curriculum guaranteed.
Adds software design/testing in C++/Haskell, not mechanical hardware design.
Nature-based coastal structures and habitat protection, not a mechanical materials/structures sequence.
Water risks and integrated governance/planning; not a fluid-mechanics/thermal-science course.
Soil/aquifer field/lab assessment, not engineering flow/heat transfer.
Biogeochemical/geochemical modelling and recovery processes, not engineering materials/manufacture.
Ancient manufacture as social/religious material-culture inquiry; not modern engineering manufacture.

judgment: No defensible closest response established. Coherent computational/sustainability concept is preserved; lack of qualification or an exact match count is not the reason.

workbookFieldDifferences.method: Inspect profile alongside description2, topics and methods. An omission is not a contradiction or proof of absence. Where scope differs, test the broader favorable interpretation before deciding target comparability.
cases: DISMATH312 engineering/state-space summary versus LTI-transform profile
DISGATE102 linear-algebra summary versus calculus-focused profile
ENSGATE101 broad scientific-foundation summary versus planetary-boundary profile
workbookFieldDifferences.effectOnJudgment: The strongest positive case gains genuine engineering/control and scientific foundations. The whole composition still organises computational and environmental inquiry without sustained integration of physical mechanical-system behaviour/design. This is a judgment of the assembled response, not a denial of those course connections.
